name: Exp_SilverTrend
summary: This EA trades based on the SilverTrend_Signal custom indicator, opening buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals. It supports configurable money management modes, stop loss/take profit, and optional position closing on reverse signals. The strategy is a signal-based breakout system that enters on new bar formations when the indicator produces non-empty values.
summary_zh: 该EA基于SilverTrend_Signal自定义指标进行交易，在指标产生上穿信号时开多仓，下穿信号时开空仓。支持可配置的资金管理模式、止损止盈，以及反向信号平仓功能。策略属于信号驱动型突破系统，在新K线形成且指标产生有效值时入场。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用SilverTrend_Signal指标检测趋势突破信号进行交易。入场条件：当指标缓冲区1（UpValue）在指定SignalBar上产生非零且非EMPTY_VALUE的值时触发买入信号，当缓冲区0（DnValue）产生有效值时触发卖出信号。出场条件：支持止损和止盈硬出场，同时也支持反向信号平仓——即当买入信号出现时平掉卖仓，卖出信号出现时平掉买仓。仓位管理：提供5种资金管理模式，包括固定手数、基于余额百分比、基于可用保证金百分比等。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode参数选择计算模式。该EA还包含额外的反向信号搜索逻辑，当同时启用开仓和平仓时，会向前遍历历史K线寻找更早的反向信号以确认平仓，这增加了策略的保守性但也可能导致延迟平仓。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy uses the SilverTrend_Signal indicator to detect trend breakout signals for trading. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when indicator buffer 1 (UpValue) produces a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE value on the specified SignalBar; a sell signal triggers when buffer 0 (DnValue) produces a valid value. Exit conditions include hard stop loss and take profit, as well as reverse signal closing — buy signals close sell positions and sell signals close buy positions. Position sizing supports 5 money management modes including fixed lot, balance percentage, and free margin percentage. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter for risk ratio and MMMode for the calculation mode. The EA also includes an additional reverse signal search logic: when both open and close on reverse are enabled, it scans forward through historical bars to find earlier reverse signals for confirmation, which adds conservatism but may delay position closing.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or lot size, meaning per MMMode

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 资金管理模式（固定手数/余额百分比/可用保证金百分比等）

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许反向信号平买仓
parameters.description_en: Allow closing buy positions on reverse signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许反向信号平卖仓
parameters.description_en: Allow closing sell positions on reverse signal

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于获取信号的K线索引

pros: 支持多种资金管理模式，灵活性高，适合不同风险偏好的交易者
止损止盈参数可配置，风险控制手段明确
提供开仓和平仓的独立开关，可以灵活组合只开不平或只平不开的策略模式
使用IsNewBar机制控制信号检测频率，避免同一K线内重复交易
pros_en: Supports multiple money management modes with high flexibility for different risk preferences
Configurable stop loss and take profit provide clear risk control mechanisms
Independent switches for opening and closing allow flexible strategy combinations such as open-only or close-only modes
Uses IsNewBar mechanism to control signal detection frequency, preventing repeated trades within the same bar
cons: 依赖外部自定义指标SilverTrend_Signal，指标逻辑不透明，难以验证信号有效性
止损1000点和止盈2000点的默认值过大，对于大多数品种可能导致风险敞口过高
反向信号搜索逻辑遍历全部历史K线，在长历史数据上可能造成性能问题
缺乏点差过滤、交易时段过滤和市场条件过滤机制
没有持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同方向持仓时重复开仓
cons_en: Depends on the external custom SilverTrend_Signal indicator whose logic is opaque and hard to verify
Default stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are excessively large for most instruments, leading to high risk exposure
The reverse signal search logic iterates through all historical bars, potentially causing performance issues on long history data
Lacks spread filter, trading session filter, and market condition filter mechanisms
No position check logic — may open duplicate positions in the same direction
improvements: 添加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓
增加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，提高交易质量
优化反向信号搜索逻辑，限制最大搜索K线数量以提升性能
improvements_en: Add position check logic to prevent duplicate openings in the same direction
Add spread filter and trading session filter to improve trade quality
Optimize reverse signal search logic by limiting maximum bar count to improve performance

risk_points: 默认止损1000点/止盈2000点过大，单笔风险敞口极高
缺乏同方向持仓检查，可能导致重复开仓放大风险
依赖外部指标且指标逻辑不透明，信号可靠性无法验证
risk_points_en: Default SL/TP of 1000/2000 points are excessively large, creating very high per-trade risk exposure
No same-direction position check may lead to duplicate openings amplifying risk
Dependency on external indicator with opaque logic makes signal reliability unverifiable

The strategy is a signal-based breakout system that enters on new bar formations when the indicator produces non-empty values.
